title: 第5章 购买灵种金丹俞家第6章 开辟灵田灵穴
content_zh:
对于这次的金香灵鱼饲养，他们并未打算立即购置控温阵法，而是准备作为一次二阶灵鱼的饲养试验。
通常而言，饲养二阶灵鱼的过程相当复杂，需要反复尝试才能寻找正确的饲养方法。
李家此次也是抱着探索的心态来进行培育。
售卖金香灵鱼的修士来自周家，而这些灵鱼的价格也出现了显着下降，昨日还是一块灵石一条，今天已经降至半块灵石一条。
显然，周家确实在急于出售这些金香灵鱼。
李松鹤选购了二十条金香灵鱼，支付了十块灵石后便离开了摊位。
周家的摊主目送李松鹤祖孙离去的身影，心中暗暗记下了这两位买家。
金香灵鱼并非任何势力都有能力饲养的灵鱼，因此记住潜在的买家，也是为了日后有机会能够收购一些成熟的金香灵鱼。
然而，当这位摊主得知李松鹤祖孙二人属于李家之后，便失去了进一步关注的兴趣。
毕竟，李家只是一个炼气级别的势力，能够将金香灵鱼饲养到一阶上品已是不易，几乎不可能出现一阶极品，更不用说二阶的金香灵鱼了。
正当李松鹤准备离开之时，李衍道忽然叫住了他：“爷爷，我们不妨再购买一些适合在水中生长的灵植种子。
将来可以在金香灵鱼的灵湖中试种，看看是否能为这些灵鱼提供遮阳或其他益处。”
李松鹤眸光一亮，赞同地说道：“孙儿说得对，对于金香灵鱼的饲养，我们现在需要摸索出一套合适的种植方案。
因此，确实应该购买一些适合水中生长的灵植来搭配种植，很多灵鱼都喜欢这样的生态环境。”
说完，李松鹤略作思量，便拉着李衍道朝最近的一家灵种店铺走去。
一盏茶的工夫后，祖孙二人来到了一家名为“赵家灵种店”的店铺门前。
赵家是一个以灵植师着称的家族，在炼气势力中颇有声望。
族内擅长培育一阶灵种，每年仅靠售卖灵种便能获得丰厚的收益。
灵种是灵植的种子，每当灵植收获时，都会精心挑选那些圆润饱满的种子，通过灵种凝练秘术进行育种，这些种子不仅成活率高，产量也非常可观。
然而，培育灵种并非易事，一般势力难以做到这一点，因为它需要借助灵植师独特的育种秘术。

而对于李家这样的炼气势力来说，除了饲养胖头鲤和掌握一些基础的云雨术之外，并没有得到更多修仙技艺的传承。
“两位道友，不知你们在寻觅何种灵种？”
刚一踏入这间古朴典雅的店铺，柜台后一位温文尔雅的修士便面带微笑地迎了上来。
李松鹤目光微抬，与之对视。
这位修士修为已达炼气后期，在琉璃海域算是高阶修士了。
他嘴角轻扬，回以温和一笑：“我们意在寻找几种适于水中栽种的灵植，不知贵店可有珍品推荐？”
柜台前的修士闻言，眼中闪过一丝了然，随即颔首道：“水中灵植虽非本店主营，但亦不乏精品。
殿内有三种可供选择，分别是浮青藻、碧水莲和水香蒲，除了碧水莲是一阶极品灵种外，另外两种都是一阶下品。”
言罢，柜台前修士的目光转向李松鹤，静待其决定。
而此时，李松鹤则将询问的目光投向了一旁的孙儿。
李衍道缓步上前，声音清朗：“敢问这三种灵植，价值几何？”
柜台前的修士答道：“碧水莲灵种，品质上乘，每粒需灵石一枚，至于浮青藻与水香蒲，则较为普遍，十粒仅需灵石一枚。”
李衍道略作思量，片刻后，果断开口：“如此，请为我们备上十颗碧水莲灵种，另两种各备百粒。”
柜台前的修士闻言，眸中精光一闪，显然对这笔交易颇为满意。
他迅速撤去了柜台上用于保护灵种的禁制，小心翼翼地取出那三种灵种，仔细包裹于布袋之中，恭敬地呈递给李家二人。
李衍道与祖父李松鹤逐一打开布袋，细致地检验着每一粒灵种。
只见那些灵种颗粒饱满，色泽鲜亮，毫无半点瑕疵，显然是上乘之选。
确认无误后，李衍道当即从储物戒中取出三十枚灵石，爽快地完成了交易。
水中灵植或许是因为培育麻烦，故而很少有灵植师培育，要不然这碧水莲作为一阶极品灵种，价格绝不会如此便宜。
content_en:
Regarding the breeding of golden fragrant spirit fish this time, they did not plan to purchase a temperature control array immediately, but prepared it as a breeding experiment for second-order spirit fish.
Generally speaking, the process of raising second-level spirit fish is quite complicated, and it requires repeated attempts to find the correct way to raise it.
This time, the Li family also carried out cultivation with an exploratory mentality.
The monk who sells the golden fragrant spiritual fish is from the Zhou family, and the price of these spiritual fish has also dropped significantly. Yesterday it was one spiritual stone, but today it has dropped to half a spiritual stone.
Obviously, the Zhou family is really eager to sell these golden fragrant fish.
Li Songhe selected twenty golden fragrant spirit fish, paid ten spirit stones and left the stall.
The stall owner of the Zhou family watched Li Songhe's ancestors and grandson leave, and secretly made a note of these two buyers in his mind.
The Golden Fragrance Spirit Fish is not a spirit fish that any force can raise, so keeping potential buyers in mind is also to have the opportunity to purchase some mature Golden Fragrance Spirit Fish in the future.
However, when the stall owner learned that Li Songhe's ancestors and grandsons belonged to the Li family, he lost interest in paying further attention.
After all, the Li family is only a force at the Qi refining level, and it is not easy to raise the Golden Fragrance Spirit Fish to the first level. It is almost impossible to have the first level, let alone the second level Golden Fragrance Spirit Fish.
Just as Li Songhe was about to leave, Li Yandao suddenly stopped him: "Grandpa, we might as well buy some more spiritual plant seeds suitable for growing in water.
In the future, it could be trialled in the spirit lakes of golden fragrant spirit fish to see if it can provide shade or other benefits to these spirit fish. "
Li Songhe's eyes lit up and he said in agreement: "My grandson is right, we now need to figure out a suitable planting plan for raising Golden Fragrant Spirit Fish.
Therefore, you should really buy some spiritual plants suitable for growing in water to match the planting. Many spiritual fish like this kind of ecological environment. "
After saying that, Li Songhe thought for a moment, then pulled Li Yandao towards the nearest spiritual seed shop.
After a cup of tea, the grandfather and grandson arrived in front of a shop called "Zhao Jia Ling Zhong Shop".
The Zhao family is a family known as spiritual planters and is quite prestigious among the Qi refining forces.
The clan is good at cultivating first-level spiritual seeds, and can earn huge profits every year just by selling spiritual seeds.
Spirit seeds are the seeds of spiritual plants. Whenever spiritual plants are harvested, those round and plump seeds will be carefully selected and bred through the secret technique of spiritual seed condensation. These seeds not only have a high survival rate, but also have a very impressive yield.
However, cultivating spiritual seeds is not easy, and it is difficult for ordinary forces to do this, because it requires the unique breeding secrets of spiritual planters.
For Qi refining forces like the Li family, apart from raising fat-headed carps and mastering some basic cloud and rain techniques, they have not received any more inheritance of immortal cultivation skills.
"Two fellow Taoists, what kind of spiritual seed are you looking for?"
As soon as he stepped into this simple and elegant shop, he was greeted by a gentle monk behind the counter with a smile.
Li Songhe raised his eyes slightly and looked at her.
This monk has reached the advanced stage of Qi refining and is considered a high-level monk in the Glazed Sea Area.
He raised the corner of his mouth and smiled gently: "We are looking for some spiritual plants suitable for planting in water. I wonder if your store has any recommendations for treasures?"
When the monk in front of the counter heard this, a glimmer of understanding flashed in his eyes, and then he nodded and said: "Although the water spiritual plants are not our main business, there are still some high-quality products.
There are three types to choose from in the palace, namely floating green algae, green water lotus and water cattail. Except for the green water lotus, which is a first-order top-grade spiritual species, the other two are first-order low-grade. "
After saying this, the monk in front of the counter turned his eyes to Li Songhe, waiting for his decision.
At this time, Li Songhe turned his questioning eyes to his grandson beside him.
Li Yandao stepped forward slowly and said in a clear voice, "May I ask how much these three spiritual plants are worth?"
The monk in front of the counter replied: "The green water lotus spiritual seed is of high quality. Each grain requiresOne spiritual stone is needed. As for floating green algae and water cattails, they are more common, and only one spiritual stone is needed for ten. "
Li Yandao thought for a while, and after a moment, he said decisively: "In this case, please prepare ten green water lotus spiritual seeds for us, and prepare a hundred of each of the other two types. "
When the monk in front of the counter heard this, his eyes flashed, and he was obviously quite satisfied with the deal.
He quickly removed the restrictions on the counter to protect the spiritual seeds, carefully took out the three spiritual seeds, carefully wrapped them in a cloth bag, and respectfully presented them to the Li family.
Li Yandao and his grandfather Li Songhe opened the cloth bags one by one and carefully inspected each spiritual seed.
I saw that those spiritual seeds were full of grains, bright in color, and without any flaws. They were obviously the best choice.
After confirming that it was correct, Li Yandao immediately took out thirty spiritual stones from the storage ring and completed the transaction readily.
Water spiritual plants may be difficult to cultivate, so few spiritual planters cultivate them. Otherwise, as a first-class spiritual plant, the green water lotus would never be so cheap.
